mapper.update: UPDATE public.auth_sms_challenge SET status = 'INVALIDATED', updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = 0, version = version + 1 WHERE mobile_hash = #{mobileHash} AND purpose = #{purpose} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'VERIFIED') AND is_deleted = false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.auth_sms_challenge ( challenge_id, purpose, mobile_hash, code_hash, provider_config_id, template_config_id, attempts, status, sent_time, expires_at, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{challengeId}, #{purpose}, #{mobileHash}, #{codeHash}, #{providerConfigId}, #{templateConfigId}, 0, 'PENDING', #{sentTime}, #{expiresAt}, 0, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT id, challenge_id, purpose, mobile_hash, code_hash, provider_config_id, template_config_id, attempts, status, sent_time, expires_at, consumed_time, version FROM public.auth_sms_challenge WHERE challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND is_deleted = false LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE public.auth_sms_challenge SET status = 'CONSUMED', consumed_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = 0, version = version + 1 WHERE challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND attempts < #{maxAttempts} AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND is_deleted = false

UPDATE public.auth_sms_challenge SET attempts = attempts + 1, status = CASE WHEN attempts + 1 >= #{maxAttempts} THEN 'INVALIDATED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = 0, version = version + 1 WHERE challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND attempts < #{maxAttempts} AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND is_deleted = false

UPDATE public.auth_sms_challenge SET status = 'EXPIRED', updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = 0, version = version + 1 WHERE challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'VERIFIED') AND expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND is_deleted = false

UPDATE public.auth_sms_challenge SET status = 'INVALIDATED', updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = 0, version = version + 1 WHERE challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'VERIFIED') AND is_deleted = false
